_fixture_note: Hand-written from PriceCharting's documented /api/products response shape (https://www.pricecharting.com/api-documentation). console-name is the real human display form their site and API use ('PAL Super Nintendo Entertainment System'), not the pal-super-nintendo URL slug - see adapters/pricecharting.js's searchInCategory(). Nobody on this build has a PriceCharting key ($49/month) to record a real search, and an NTSC row is included deliberately so the PAL match has to pick the right one out of several rather than the only one.
